title: JPMorgan Q4 2025 record annual profit
content: JPMorgan Chase reported Q4 2025 net income of $14.0 billion, or $4.81 per share, beating analyst estimates. Full-year 2025 net income reached a record $58.5 billion. Net interest income was $23.5 billion for the quarter.

title: JPMorgan investment banking revenue surges
content: Investment banking fees rose 49% year-over-year to $2.6 billion in Q4 2025, driven by strong M&A advisory and equity underwriting activity. The pipeline remains robust heading into 2026.

title: JPMorgan credit quality remains stable
content: Net charge-off rate was 1.42% in Q4 2025, within management guidance. Provision for credit losses was $2.6 billion. Consumer credit metrics showed resilience despite higher-for-longer interest rate environment.
